name: Merchant Role
definition: Party performing the card payment transaction.

MerchantCategoryCode.name: Merchant Category Code
MerchantCategoryCode.definition: Category code conform to ISO 18245, related to the type of services or goods the merchant provides for the transaction.

MerchantIdentification.name: Merchant Identification
MerchantIdentification.definition: Number that identifies the merchant to the card issuer.
